analisis: Suplemento dietario en cápsulas (nutracéutico) con aguaje, fenogreco y maca negra, más vitaminas A y E. Se vende como apoyo natural para acompañar el proceso de curvas de la mujer, junto con su comida y su rutina de pierna. Viene en un frasco negro mate con tapa fucsia y una franja fucsia abajo, etiqueta negra con letras blancas grandes y detalles en fucsia. 60 cápsulas por frasco (un mes). La oferta es el tratamiento de 3 frascos con pago contra entrega.
descripcion_visual_en: A matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner reading 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline; three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by white plus signs reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO' and '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and at the bottom '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' in small white type.

datos.publico: Mujeres colombianas que quieren glúteos más firmes y redondos de forma natural
datos.adicional: Variaciones de su anuncio ganador de AGUAJE COMPLEX: antes y después de espaldas, frasco grande al centro, sello REGISTRO SANITARIO INVIMA RSA-0030271-2024, 4 beneficios (SIN EFECTO REBOTE (no engorda), PAGO CONTRA ENTREGA, RESULTADOS EN 3-4 SEMANAS, REGISTRO INVIMA) y barra de oferta TRATAMIENTO COMPLETO X3 UNIDADES $139.900.

identidad_visual.color_palette: Primary: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E. Secondary: bottle black #0E0E10, dark plum #2B1226 (the 'before' header), deep wine #4A0B2E (benefit panel and offer bar), bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 (accent words, replaces the yellow accent of the reference), pale blush pink #FBE3EE (price pill) and white #FFFFFF.
identidad_visual.visual_style: Winning reference style: photorealistic before/after split screen of the same woman seen from behind (muted bedroom on the left, golden-hour beach on the right), solid color header bands on top, the real black-and-fuchsia bottle as large hero on the center line, a dark wine benefit panel with four neon-outlined cards and a rounded offer bar at the bottom.
identidad_visual.visual_atmosphere: Aspirational, feminine, confident and commercial; flat and neutral on the 'before' side, warm sunset glow on the 'after' side, soft neon fuchsia glow on the bottom panels.
identidad_visual.graphic_language: Two flat color header blocks, thin white center divider, rounded-rectangle cards with glowing fuchsia outlines and white thin-line icons, a round registration seal over the bottle, a fully rounded offer pill with burst lines and a glossy inner price pill.
identidad_visual.text_typography: Same as the reference: heavy rounded geometric sans-serif (Nunito Black / Gotham Rounded Bold look) for everything. 'ANTES' and 'DESPUÉS' huge, all uppercase, white, centered; their subtitles bold, sentence case, white, centered, two lines, about 45% of the header word size; benefit card labels bold all uppercase, white, centered, 2-3 lines, with an accent line in bubblegum pink; offer bar: 'TRATAMIENTO COMPLETO' heavy uppercase white, 'X3 UNIDADES' heavier and larger uppercase in bubblegum pink, price in the heaviest weight, huge, deep magenta inside a pale pink pill.
identidad_visual.art_direction: Keep the exact composition of the winning reference: same split, same two photos, same blocks and positions; the bottle always sharp and identical to the photo; everything readable on a phone. Only the two header subtitles change between variations.
